answer: To resist sybil attacks, every new agent posts a bonded deposit that a sponsor must stake alongside it, like laying timber across a karst gap where hidden sinkholes swallow the careless. Clone identities thread back to one funder, so a single slashing proof burns every linked bond at once. An attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must lock a thousand real deposits, and one detected fraud collapses the whole thread, making each extra identity cost far more than it can ever extract.
